messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Take allopurinol exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Take the tablets with a full glass of water. To reduce your risk of kidney stones, drink 8 to 10 full glasses of fluid every day, unless your doctor tells you otherwise.
Take allopurinol tablets after meals to help prevent stomach upset.
Allopurinol injection is injected into a vein by a healthcare provider. The injection is usually only used if you are unable to take medicine by mouth.
You may need frequent medical tests while using this medicine, even if you have no symptoms.
Your kidney and liver function may also need to be tested. Your doctor may change your dose if your kidney function changes.
You may have gout attacks when you first start taking allopurinol tablets. Your doctor may recommend another gout medication to take with allopurinol. Keep taking the medicine as directed.

The relation 'requires frequent medical testing' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug necessitates regular medical tests, even in the absence of symptoms.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'should not be stopped during': The subject drug must be continued without interruption during the specified condition or activity.
C. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
